Rejoignez Nous

À propos de cette opportunité

Nous sommes à la recherche d’un(e) stagiaire en automatisation DevOps motivé(e) et curieux(se) pour se joindre à l’équipe d’Ericsson. Dans ce rôle, vous travaillerez aux côtés de professionnels expérimentés afin d’apprendre comment les solutions d’automatisation, d’intégration et de déploiement sont conçues, développées, testées et soutenues.

Vous contribuerez au développement et à l’amélioration des pipelines CI/CD, des outils d’automatisation et des processus opérationnels qui soutiennent les équipes de développement et d’exploitation. Avec l’appui de l’équipe, vous aiderez à maintenir la fiabilité des environnements, à investiguer les incidents et à soutenir les activités de déploiement et d’intégration tout au long du cycle de vie des applications.

Ce stage vous permettra d’acquérir une expérience concrète des pratiques DevOps et d’automatisation tout en contribuant à des initiatives technologiques et d’affaires importantes.

Ce que vous ferez



- Participer au développement et aux tests de solutions d’automatisation sous la supervision d’ingénieurs expérimentés.
- Contribuer aux activités de tests unitaires et de validation afin de s’assurer que les composantes répondent aux critères d’acceptation.
- Aider à maintenir les outils, scripts et solutions d’automatisation, ainsi que leur documentation.
- Soutenir les activités opérationnelles, notamment les déploiements, l’exécution de tâches automatisées et la surveillance des systèmes.
- Participer à l’analyse des incidents, à l’identification de correctifs potentiels et à la documentation des résultats.
- Appuyer les activités de déploiement logiciel et d’intégration dans les environnements cibles.
- Contribuer aux discussions entourant l’efficacité des processus, la fiabilité des systèmes et les occasions d’amélioration continue.

Les compétences que vous apportez



- Connaissance de base des principes DevOps, de l’automatisation, de l’intégration continue (CI) et du déploiement continu (CD).
- Familiarité avec les concepts de développement logiciel et de tests logiciels acquise dans le cadre de cours, de projets ou d’expériences antérieures.
- Compréhension de base des systèmes, des environnements infonuagiques ou des infrastructures TI.
- Une exposition aux outils d’automatisation, de déploiement ou de gestion de configuration constitue un atout.
- Intérêt à apprendre les processus de validation, de tests d’acceptation utilisateur (UAT) et d’amélioration continue.
- Bonnes aptitudes d’analyse et de résolution de problèmes, avec un intérêt pour l’investigation et le dépannage.
- Capacité à collaborer efficacement, à poser des questions et à communiquer clairement.
- Être actuellement inscrit(e) à un programme universitaire ou collégial en informatique, génie logiciel, génie informatique, systèmes d’information ou dans un domaine connexe.
fit_why: Intern DevOps automation role; he has Docker/GitHub Actions but limited ops exposure

Nuovo Artistic Studios is the premier destination for all things self-love. A by-women company and one of the largest artistic photography companies in North America, Nuovo is on a mission to empower individuals by fostering confidence and self-expression while celebrating intimacy and individuality.
 We’re looking for a Software Developer Intern to join our team. This role is ideal for a student who is eager to grow their development skills, gain hands-on experience building real-world products and explore how AI is transforming the way software is developed. You’ll contribute to internal applications, collaborate on ongoing product development and learn how to build, test, and maintain software in a collaborative, fast-paced environment. We’re looking for someone who is curious, proactive and excited about building products. 
 This Internship will take place from January 11th to April 30th, 2027 
 What You’ll Do:
 
• Contribute to small features, UI improvements and bug fixes across our internal applications 
• Support our team on ongoing product development, feature requests and development tickets 
• Write and maintain clear technical documentation to support our applications and development processes 
• Test new features, perform quality assurance and help ensure applications are reliable before releases 
• Participate in code reviews and collaborate on implementing clean, maintainable code  
• Join product planning discussions and contribute ideas to improve our tools, workflows and user experience  
• Explore AI-powered coding tools and emerging development practices to help improve productivity and the way we build software

About You:
 
• Currently pursuing a diploma or degree in Software Engineering, Information Technology, Computer Science or a related field, with plans to return to school following the Internship  
• Comfortable with full-stack development, including Python and web development across front-end and back-end environments 
• Familiar with Git and fundamental development practices, including code reviews, testing and documentation 
• Curious about UI/UX design and creating intuitive, user-friendly experiences; experience in this area is an asset 
• Up to date on AI coding tools and interested in how AI is changing software development 
• Interested in product development and understanding how software solves real-world problems 
• A strong communicator who enjoys collaborating with others, adaptable and eager to learn  
• Fluent in English and French is considered a strong asset

What We Offer:
 
• Inspiring Work Environment: Immerse yourself in a creative, collaborative company where artistry and empowerment converge. 
• Growth Opportunities: Be part of a fast-growing company committed to nurturing talent and fostering career development. 
• Recognition and Support: A team that values your contributions and celebrates your success. 
• Exclusive Perks: Access to Nuovo’s services and products, ensuring you, too, can experience the power of portraiture. We also provide you with a 50% Family & Friends discount. About Us:
 Nuovo Artistic Studios is not just a photography studio; it’s a movement designed to uplift, empower, and transform. Our mission is to provide every guest with a luxury experience that inspires confidence and celebrates individuality. With studios across North America, we are redefining the art of modern portraiture, one empowered story at a time.
 This is your opportunity to join a team dedicated to excellence and artistry. Become part of the Nuovo legacy and make an impact, one unforgettable moment at a time.
 This is your moment. Apply today!
fit_why: Full-stack Python/web internship; strong overlap with his stack

Come make your difference in communities across Canada, where authenticity, trust and making connections is valued – as we shape the future of Canadian retail, together. Our unique position as one of the country's largest employers, coupled with our commitment to positively impact the lives of all Canadians, provides our colleagues a range of opportunities and experiences to help Canadians Live Life Well®.

At Loblaw Companies Limited, we succeed through collaboration and commitment and set a high bar for ourselves and those around us. Whether you are just starting your career, re-entering the workforce, or looking for a new job, this is where you belong. 
 
 Winter 2027 Work Term 
 Term Length: 4 months
 Term Start: January 6, 2027
 Term End: April 16, 2027
 
 The pay range for the co-op student role will reflect factors such as the candidate's experience, academic level, and the specific skillset required for the role.
 
 Loblaw has adopted the following hybrid working model (a combination of working between the office and remotely). Colleagues can work remotely up to 1 day a week, while spending the other 4 days in the office (to be determined by each business unit).
 
 About Loblaws: 
 At Loblaw, we help millions of Canadians get through their best days, worst days, celebration days, and every day. Through our innovation and quality products, we’re here for our friends, neighbours, family members and colleagues.
 
 Come make your difference in communities across Canada, where authenticity, trust and making connections is valued – as we shape the future of Canadian retail, together. Our unique position as one of the country's largest employers, coupled with our commitment to positively impact the lives of all Canadians, provides our colleagues a range of opportunities and experiences to help Canadians Live Life Well®.

 Position Overview: 
 Join our Applied Machine Learning team and help solve real operational challenges across one of Canada's largest supply chains. Although our team is called Applied Machine Learning, our day-to-day work focuses primarily on software development, data engineering, and process automation. We build Python applications, SQL solutions, dashboards, and internal tools that save hundreds of hours of manual work and improve supply chain operations. Machine learning is occasionally part of our toolkit, but it is not the primary focus of this role.
 You may work on projects such as:
 
• Building Python applications that automate manual business processes 
• Writing SQL against enterprise data warehouses (BigQuery and Oracle) 
• Developing internal dashboards and reporting tools 
• Integrating systems using APIs 
• Designing workflows that eliminate repetitive operational tasks 
• Working directly with business partners to understand problems and deliver practical solutions 
• Building and maintaining scalable data pipelines that support reporting, analytics, and operational applications. 
• Developing solutions within Google Cloud Platform (GCP) and Windows virtual machine environments. You'll own real projects from concept to production—not just small pieces of larger initiatives. From gathering business requirements through design, development, testing, deployment, and ongoing support, you'll experience the full software development lifecycle while receiving mentorship from the team.
 
 Responsibilities: 
 
• Develop Python applications that automate supply chain processes. 
• Write efficient SQL queries against enterprise-scale datasets in BigQuery and Oracle. 
• Design, build, test, and deploy internal tools used by Supply Chain teams across Canada. 
• Partner directly with business users to understand operational challenges and translate them into technical solutions. 
• Investigate production issues, troubleshoot problems, and continuously improve existing automation. 
• Create clear technical documentation to ensure solutions are maintainable and easy to support. 
• Continuously identify opportunities to eliminate manual work through automation. 
 Technologies you'll use: 
 
• Python 
• SQL (Google BigQuery & Oracle) 
• Google Cloud Platform 
• Jupyter Notebooks 
• Power BI 
• Git 
• Jira 
• Confluence 
• Windows and Linux development environments 
 What you’ll need: 
 
• Post-secondary education in Computer Science, Data Science, Engineering, or a related field. 
• Experience writing Python applications and SQL queries. Exposure to cloud platforms such as Google Cloud Platform (preferred), AWS, or Azure is an asset. 
• Strong curiosity and a willingness to independently learn new technologies. 
• Resourceful and comfortable researching unfamiliar problems independently while knowing when to seek guidance. 
• Enjoys solving ambiguous business problems with practical software solutions. 
• Able to work independently while communicating progress and asking thoughtful questions when needed. 
• Strong attention to detail and a desire to build reliable, maintainable software. 
 
 Please note Loblaw's Return to Office policy is 4 days in the office. 
 Our commitment to Sustainability and Social Impact is an essential part of the way we do business, and we focus our attention on areas where we can have the greatest impact. Our approach to sustainability and social impact is based on three pillars – Environment, Sourcing and Community – and we are constantly looking for ways to demonstrate leadership in these important areas. Our CORE Values – Care, Ownership, Respect and Excellence – guide all our decision-making and come to life through our Blue Culture. We offer our colleagues progressive careers, comprehensive training, flexibility, and other competitive benefits – these are some of the many reasons why we are one of Canada’s Top Employers, Canada’s Best Diversity Employers, Canada’s Greenest Employers & Canada’s Top Employers for Young People.
 
 If you are unsure whether your experience matches every requirement above, we encourage you to apply anyway. We are looking for varied perspectives which include diverse experiences that we can add to our team.

We have a long-standing focus on diversity, equity and inclusion because we know it will make our company a better place to work and shop. We are committed to creating accessible environments for our colleagues, candidates and customers. Requests for accommodation due to a disability (which may be visible or invisible, temporary or permanent) can be made at any stage of application and employment. We encourage candidates to make their accommodation needs known so that we can provide equitable opportunities.    
   
 Please Note :
Candidates who are 18 years or older are required to complete a criminal background check. Details will be provided through the application process.
